title: Wind more turns per metre
hook: Change turn density and predict interior magnetic-field magnitude.
misconception: interior magnetic-field magnitude stays fixed when turn density doubles.
objective: Apply B = μ₀nI to compare interior magnetic-field magnitude when turn density changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With an ideal long solenoid with fixed current, B = μ₀nI. When turn density doubles, interior magnetic-field magnitude becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model B = μ₀nI; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider an ideal long solenoid with fixed current, with a nonzero initial result. If turn density triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on interior magnetic-field magnitude?
recall.why: Apply B = μ₀nI under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
